sources.text: Lactic-rennet curd set 24 h; surface wiped with white wine and salt, yellow-red rind; ripened two months and more in cellars; raw cow milk with some goat milk. Italian PAT (Lombardy), Swiss Slow Food Presidium (Valle di Muggio). Italian variant sometimes made from ricotta ('mascarpa'). Max of 90 days is an assumption on 'two months and more'.
